subject.title: [Feature]: Expose sessionKey/runId to outbound message hook for deterministic verification

question: Should outbound pre-send plugin hooks expose same-turn transcript/tool-call/result evidence, and what redaction, permission, and field-shape contract should own that access?
rationale: The remaining work changes a public plugin API and can expose sensitive session/tool data before delivery, so automation cannot safely choose the evidence scope or security boundary.

options.title: Add bounded evidence contract
options.body: Expose run identity plus capped, redacted same-turn verification evidence on the chosen pre-send hook with documented permission semantics.

options.title: Land identity first
options.body: Thread outbound runId/message identity now and defer transcript/tool-result evidence to a separate public SDK design.

options.title: Treat payload hook as enough
options.body: Close the request as covered by reply_payload_sending, accepting that plugins still lack first-class tool/result evidence for claim verification.

recommendation.title: Add bounded evidence contract
recommendation.body: Expose run identity plus capped, redacted same-turn verification evidence on the chosen pre-send hook with documented permission semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the prior review, merged the most relevant hook-context PRs, and is closest to the product/security boundary evidence here.
